applicant.name: Dr. Sophie Lechner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: What proportion of patients with depression has an active SSRI, by data holder?
definitions: Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
SSRI = ATC code starting with N06AB.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per data holder: patients with depression and % with an active SSRI, one decimal.
